notes:
Full-depth fan-out: family "Platform understanding — deployment, worlds, model serving, wayfinder". Scene ids derive from the bound record paths; glyph terms are the bound records' own heading words. Presentation mappings are declared craft. Not corpus-complete claims beyond the frozen inventory: see the product receipt fulldepth-receipt-2026-09-21.md for exclusions and census-delta notes.

Moves: deployment profiles hold (reference specimens pinned), the development worlds emerge (Development Field S5 — the placed worlds where development lives), model-serving conformance holds, the place census turns (the pid table reconciled; request/release is the census's own pair — walked), bounded resource observations gather, and the Wayfinder walks (issue #1 as the executable source of the graph).

3D: the member's depth is situated placement in a room — z is the Workcell's own here-ness: the workstation face nearest, the placed world deepest (laminated; depthPerspective on). Pointers: guard=placed bounds hold, gather=material gathered, vortex=lifecycle turns, rupture=the demand cuts in, settle=the room at rest. Automation: one LFO per member — the placed world breathes. Sequences walk each record's own heading words — placement is the Workcell's native grammar.
